title: Kirkpatrick lobbied against the UAP Disclosure Act
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Kirkpatrick lobbied against the UAP Disclosure Act, about 2023-2024 at Washington, D.C., and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And hopefully, when the UAP Disclosure Act goes up for vote again, Sean Kirkpatrick won't lobby against it like he did last time.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Sean Kirkpatrick, who once led a Pentagon office set up to look into UAP (unidentified anomalous phenomena, the government's term for UFOs), lobbied against the UAP Disclosure Act around 2023 and 2024. That act is a proposed law meant to make the government release its UFO records. Michels says he hopes Kirkpatrick won't do it again when it next comes to a vote, since in his telling it would mean an official worked to keep the records closed.
